sections.title: Anthropic asks D.C. appeals court to rehear Pentagon blacklisting case
sections.content: Anthropic petitioned the federal appeals court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its challenge to the Pentagon's supply-chain-risk designation, according to CNBC and Bloomberg coverage dated October 13, 2026.
sections.significance: The petition escalates Anthropic's legal fight over a Pentagon security-risk designation, a dispute that could affect its standing as a government supplier.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Watch whether the D.C. appeals court grants the rehearing, which would signal how aggressively Anthropic intends to contest the Pentagon designation.
